recentItems.title: Got What It Takes to Be an SAF Specialist? 👀 | TRUTH OR CAP
recentItems.description:
Failed his first IPPT. Five months later? Gold 🫡

Now a Golden Bayonet recipient, 3SG Samuel Ng looks back on his journey through the Specialist Cadet Course and puts some assumptions about the course to the test.

Truth or Cap? Let’s find out. 🧢
